svg.title: Surface-flux parameterization: algorithm flow
svg.desc: Starting from the lowest model level and the surface state, the flow maps the lowest-level state to the surface reference height, diagnoses the bulk Richardson number, combines the neutral exchange coefficient with the stability functions, computes the momentum, sensible heat and moisture fluxes, updates the lowest model level implicitly with dimensionless exchange coefficients, and optionally returns the frictionally dissipated kinetic energy to the atmosphere as heat before the next time step.
svg.text: Next time step

how strongly one time step pulls the lowest level toward the surface state
The moisture increment is capped by the water the surface can supply
The implicit form stays stable under strong exchange — friction can never reverse the wind
